'''Ord Carpagia'''<ref name="EGTW" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Carpagia system/Legends|Carpagia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="NorthernDependencies" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Carpagia was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Carpagia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ord Carpagia, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />

Ord Carpagia also shared its name with the ''[[Carpagian]]'', a [[Saryabo IV Pinnace Scoutcraft|starship]] in service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was introduced in "[[Dandrian's Ring (adventure)|Dandrian's Ring]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chris Hind]] and published in the [[April]] [[1991]] [[Challenge 49|forty-ninth issue]] of the [[Challenge (magazine)|''Challenge'']] magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Challenge49">{{ChallengeCite|49|Dandrian's Ring (adventure)}}</ref> The adventure is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
